programs.description: Lakshmi pays Bhanu, a college student, to help her sneak into the boys' hostel. However, things take a turn when she is unable to get out and spends the night in his room.
Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.
Vijay's life takes an unexpected turn when he falls for Merin. However, he is already betrothed to Pavithra, the daughter of an affluent man.
After a radio jockey loses his voice due to excessive smoking, he walks on a difficult path to regain it by correcting his mistakes.
When Revathi's father wishes to see her when he's on his deathbed, she refuses to go as her mother taught her that he's a bad man. So her friend who's an orphan visits in place of her.
Uma is under the impression that Charlie, a musician, is in love with her until he introduces his lover, Manasi. However, Charlie later realises his love for Uma when he starts missing her.
For TV director Thomaskutty Pachu, nothing is more stressful than dealing with his pesky cousin Joseph Kovalan. That is, until a murder occurs on the set.
Lal Krishna, an eccentric criminal lawyer, defends the woman accused of Chinthamani's murder. However, he learns that there is more to the story and decides to dispense justice in his own way.
Chef Pillai welcomes 'Khalifa' team as they enjoy an Onam feast, share interesting chats.
Follow the story of six youngsters as they navigate through happiness, heartbreaks and all the challenges that life throws at them.

Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

Faizi, an aspiring chef, returns to his hometown in India when he fails to receive support from his father. He tries to fulfil his dream by helping his grandfather, Kareem, run his hotel.
Bhargavan, a criminal suffering from panic attacks that hold him back from attacking people, goes to a psychiatrist for treatment.
Gynaecologist Dr Zacharia encounters women facing unwanted pregnancies, including 18-year-old Zaria, who entrusts her newborn to the doctor after giving birth.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Anjana, a doctor, thinks that silence is golden and avoids speaking much, whereas Arvind, a salesman, loves talking. Their lives change when a strange disease called 'dumb flu' spreads in the city.
Zachariah and Balu remain best friends even after their marriage. However, things take a turn when their wives start fighting with each other.
Nandagopal raises his epileptic sister, Ammu, after their parents' death. He gets her married to Venu without telling him about her illness, but it comes to light soon and creates problems for them.

While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
Four friends, Appu, Sabu, Balan and Dileep, wish to meet their dream girl and favourite actress, Kushbhoo. Fate changes for them when Dileep gets a chance to act in a movie as Kushbhoo's hero.
